sources.title: Detection and Diagnosis of Breast Tumors using Deep Convolutional ...
sources.snippet: This paper proposes a deep learning methodology to tackle computer-aided detection of malignant breast tumors in ultrasound images using training data which contains several hundred images of benign and malignant cases and demonstrates that the fine-tuned model had the best performance.
